N.description: int, optional, default=None. Specifies the number of the columns the output matrix. If not specified, ``N = len(x)``.

increasing.description: bool, optional, default=False. Specifies the order of the powers of the columns. If ``True``, the powers increase from left to right, :math:`[x^0, x^1, ..., x^{(N-1)}]`. By default, the powers decrease from left to right :math:`[x^{(N-1)}, ..., x^1, x^0]`.

output.description: An array of shape ``[len(x), N]`` containing the generated Vandermonde matrix.
